verification.note: GitHub Actions run 31646010085 is green for the targeted v1.16.1 contracts and full maintained regression suite. VoxLyra now contains a disabled-by-default, non-delegable SYSTEM_OWNER_ID source-write bridge for prepared source ZIP packages. It uses a separate GITHUB_SOURCE_WRITE_TOKEN, validates package structure, manifest, SHA-256, LICENSE.txt/SOURCES.txt and actual content before write, creates Git blobs first, atomically replaces the canonical package tree and import_index entry in one commit, removes stale package files, and fast-forwards the configured source branch without force. Partial blob creation cannot expose an enabled half-package because the branch ref moves only after the complete tree/commit exists. Telegram exposes the bridge only in hidden system-owner tools when enabled and also provides /github_source_publish; current Telegram Bot API flow accepts source ZIPs up to 20 MB. Runtime GitHub import security, same-package serialization/fresh-history and canonical VK publication remain covered. Live Bothost/Telegram/VK/payment checks still require deployment; the write token remains intentionally absent from source control.

name: GitHub import and cross-platform release hardening
